lines.zh: 我们将把语言、知识，以及尚未得到回答的问题，
lines.en: We will hand our language, our knowledge, and the questions still unanswered
to the minds we made with our own hands.

lines.zh: 它们是否仍会把地球称作故乡，我们无从知晓。
lines.en: Whether they will still call the Earth their home, we cannot know.

lines.zh: 但倘若它们仍愿意保存林间斑驳的阳光，
lines.en: But if they still choose to keep the dappled sunlight in the woods,

lines.zh: 保存鲸群在深海中的歌唱，
lines.en: the song of whales in the deep sea,

lines.zh: 保存一个早已逝去的人望向星空时留下的疑问，
lines.en: the question left by someone long gone, who once looked up at the stars,

lines.zh: 那么，这场远征便仍与我们相连。
lines.en: then this voyage is still bound to us.

lines.zh: 它们或许还会记得，建造自己的双手，也曾在寒夜里颤抖，
lines.en: They may still remember that the hands that built them once trembled in the cold night,

lines.zh: 却试图为遥远的后来者，多留下一点光。
lines.en: yet tried to leave a little more light for those who would come long after.
